[Tireless Worker](/Spells.aspx?ID=1347)
<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Focus" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=511" />
<trait label="Healing" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=89" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 97, [Pathfinder #148: Fires of the Haunted City](/Sources.aspx?ID=13) pg. 65

**Domain**
[Toil](/Domains.aspx?ID=61)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 30 feet

**Target** 1 creature
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** sustained up to 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

You suppress your choice of one of the following conditions that's affecting the target: [clumsy](/Conditions.aspx?ID=3), [encumbered](/Conditions.aspx?ID=12), [enfeebled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=13), or [fatigued](/Conditions.aspx?ID=15). If you don't remove the effect that caused the condition, the condition returns after the spell's duration expires.
